newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - Feb 3.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - Feb 3.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in two London-based Arabic-language newspapers on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Yemen approved projects worth $778.4 million in 1996.
- Moroccan firm plans to invest $1.2 billion in phosphate project.
- Arab states need $10.5 billion a year to increase their electricity capacity until the year 2000, study.
- Qatar to build new petrochemical plant at a cost of $500 million. Firms from France and Norway will take stakes.
- Egyptian parliament worried about shortage in investments of Egyptians working abroad in Egypt.
- Kuwait Insurance Company posts $13.74 million net profit in 1996.
